title: The 5 Most Populous Countries, Ranked (#1 Changed in 2023)

scenes.text: The five most populous countries, ranked. Number one changed hands in 2023.
Number five: Pakistan. Two hundred and fifty-one million people, more than all of Brazil.
scenes.label: Pakistan · 251 million

scenes.text: Number four: Indonesia. Two hundred and eighty-three million, spread across thousands of islands.
scenes.label: Indonesia · 283 million

scenes.text: Number three: the United States. Three hundred and forty-five million, a billion fewer than number two.
scenes.label: United States · 345 million

scenes.text: Number two: China. One point four two billion, and the United Nations expects it to shrink.
scenes.label: China · 1.42 billion

scenes.text: Number one: India. It passed China in 2023, and is projected to stay on top through 2100.
scenes.label: India · 1.45 billion

description:
The five most populous countries, ranked by population in 2024.
India passed China in 2023 and is projected to remain the largest through 2100.
Which country do you think will be next on this list?
first_comment: Which country would you have put at number one ten years ago? And what should we rank next?
